hero.title: Move. Smile. Repeat.
hero.subtitle: From your first step to your first spin, PartyPas welcomes every body and every beat — Ballroom, Classic, Ballet and Latino, taught by dancers who love to teach.

intro.title: A studio built around joy
intro.text: PartyPas is an online-first dance school: browse our styles, pick a date and hour that suits you, and hop on a live Zoom class with our instructors. No pressure, no judgment — just movement.

items.title: Live, personal classes
items.text: Small groups and private sessions over Zoom, so instructors can actually watch and correct your movement.

items.title: Every level welcome
items.text: Complete beginners and returning dancers alike — we shape each class around who shows up.

items.title: Flexible scheduling
items.text: Pick an open date and hour that works for you and book it in a couple of clicks.

cta.title: Ready to move?
cta.text: Check available dates and reserve your spot — payment is arranged directly with us after booking.

danceTypes.title: Four styles, one dance floor
danceTypes.intro: Whether you're drawn to the elegance of Ballroom, the precision of Classic, the grace of Ballet, or the fire of Latino, there's a class — and an instructor — waiting for you.

ballroom.name: Ballroom
ballroom.short: Elegant partner dancing — Waltz, Tango, Foxtrot and more.
ballroom.desc: Ballroom dancing is about connection: frame, lead-and-follow, and the quiet conversation between two dancers. Our classes cover Waltz, Tango, Foxtrot and Viennese Waltz, building posture, timing and partnership from your very first lesson.

classic.name: Classic
classic.desc: Our Classic program focuses on foundational technique — alignment, musicality and clean lines — drawing on classical dance training. It's the perfect base for dancers who want strong fundamentals, whatever style they move on to next.

ballet.name: Ballet
ballet.short: Strength, grace and discipline at the barre.
ballet.desc: From first positions at the barre to center work and simple choreography, our Ballet classes build strength, flexibility and grace at any age or level, in a warm and encouraging setting.

latino.name: Latino
latino.short: Salsa, Bachata, Cha-Cha and pure energy.
latino.desc: Latino classes bring the heat: hip movement, rhythm and playful partner work across Salsa, Bachata, Cha-Cha and Rumba. Come ready to sweat, laugh and let go.

faq.q: Do I need a partner to join?
faq.a: Not at all. Many of our classes are designed for solo learners, and partner work is practiced with instructors or fellow students during class.

faq.q: What do I need for a Zoom class?
faq.a: A laptop, tablet or phone with a camera, a stable internet connection, and a bit of open floor space at home.

faq.q: How do I pay for a class?
faq.a: After you book a slot, our team will reach out to arrange payment manually — we don't process payments on the website yet.

faq.q: Can I switch between dance styles?
faq.a: Absolutely — many students explore Ballroom, Classic, Ballet and Latino together to build a well-rounded skill set.

faq.q: What if I need to reschedule?
faq.a: Just email us at letsdance@partypas.com and we'll help you find a new slot.
